verdict.rationale: Zero's first-party MCP capability list includes "Bulk archive emails", along with "Modify email labels" and "Mark emails as read/unread", so some bulk triage exists as the product's own capability. That evidence is a prose list for an agent/MCP interface, not an in-app feature where a user selects many conversations and acts on them at once. Labeling and marking done are not documented as bulk operations. missing for 10: in-app multi-select of conversations, bulk labeling, a bulk mark-done action, any UI documentation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
